# STACK.md — Technology Stack
<!-- Generated by gsd-map-codebase sequential mapping -->

## Language & Runtime

- **Language**: Python 3 (`#!/usr/bin/env python3`, `# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-`)
- **Runtime**: CPython 3.7+ (VarAmbseries docstring explicitly targets Python 3.7+)
- **OS Target**: Windows (bat launchers use `call activate`, `timeout /t`, `start cmd /k`)
- **Conda Environment**: `freq` — activated in all `.bat` launchers via `call activate freq`

## Package Dependencies

| Package | Usage | File(s) |
|---------|-------|---------|
| `pyvisa` | GPIB instrument control (Agilent 34970A) | `34970A_5.py` |
| `sympy` | Symbolic linear calibration equations | `34970A_5.py` |
| `numpy` | Scientific arrays, NaN handling, GUM uncertainty math | `34970A_5.py`, `SensorV2.py` |
| `astropy` | MJD/DOY time calculations (`astropy.time.Time`) | `34970A_5.py` |
| `bokeh` | Real-time web dashboard (served via `bokeh serve`) | `streamingLab/Visual.py`, `Visual_with_stats.py`, `main.py` |
| `tornado` | Coroutine support for Bokeh async update (`@gen.coroutine`) | `streamingLab/Visual.py` |
| `pandas` | DataFrame processing for time-series analysis | `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py`, `Visual_with_stats.py`, `Logging34970A.py` |
| `matplotlib` | Static time-series plots in Tkinter GUI | `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` |
| `tkinter` | Desktop GUI for historical analysis tool | `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` |
| `glob`, `os`, `re`, `xml.etree.ElementTree` | File I/O & XML parsing (stdlib) | multiple |
| `threading`, `functools.partial` | Thread-safe Bokeh updates | `SensorV2.py`, `main.py` |
| `datetime`, `collections.deque` | Time handling, config queues | multiple |

> No `requirements.txt`, `pyproject.toml`, `setup.py`, or `conda environment.yml` found. Dependencies must be inferred from imports.

## Frameworks

| Framework | Role | Entry Point |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| **Bokeh** (serve mode) | Real-time streaming web dashboard | `bokeh serve --show streamingLab --port 502` |
| **Tkinter** | Historical analysis desktop GUI | `python VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` |

## Configuration

- **No config files** (JSON, YAML, INI, .env) exist — all parameters are hardcoded:
  - GPIB address: `GPIB0::5::INSTR` in `34970A_5.py`
  - Bokeh port: `502` in `runVarAmb2.bat`
  - Sensor channels: `@101,102,103,104`
  - Current range: 4–20 mA
  - Shunt resistor: 268 Ω
  - Temperature range: −20 to 80 °C
  - Humidity range: 0–100 %ur
  - Trigger timer: 1 s (34970A internal), Bokeh poll: 30 s, Stats tab: 60 s

## Data Storage

- **Format**: XML files stored under `./varamblog/{YYDDD}/log_ambientvars-{YYDDD}.xml`
- **Schema**:
  ```xml
  <ambientvariables datetime="...">
    <measure timestamp="YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff">
      <RHA>...</RHA><TCA>...</TCA><RHB>...</RHB><TCB>...</TCB>
    </measure>
  </ambientvariables>
  ```
- **Directory naming**: `YYDDD` = 2-digit year + 3-digit day-of-year (e.g., `26100` = 2026, day 100)
- No database; no SQLite; no cloud storage.

## Launchers

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `runMain.bat` | Orchestrator: starts `runVarAmb.bat`, waits 20 s, starts `runVarAmb2.bat` + `runVarAmbSeries.bat` |
| `runVarAmb.bat` | Activates `freq` env, runs `34970A_5.py` (sensor logger) |
| `runVarAmb2.bat` | Activates `freq` env, runs `bokeh serve --show streamingLab --port 502` |
| `runVarAmbSeries.bat` | Activates `freq` env, runs `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` (historical analysis GUI) |
